يعتديا (form VIII)
# يَعْتَدِيَا (yaʕtadiyā) /jaʕ.ta.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# يُعْتَدَيَا (yuʕtadayā) /juʕ.ta.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
